Elena (AE): Heads up -- Riverview signed the MSA and asked for a 1-week POC. They want to validate a custom 22B sparse-finetuned variant into our catalog. Need compatibility + CCQ responses.
Diego (Solutions Eng): Cool. Do they provide the tokenizer and model artifact? Also what hardware/latency targets?
Elena (AE): They will share a GCS link to model + tokenizer. Target: p99 < 120ms for 2k context, mostly chat with 5-10 token turns.
Sam (Infra): 22B @2k context + p99 120ms on shared hosted is optimistic. Need quant type (fp16 vs int8) and whether custom fused kernels are required.
Elena (AE): Customer says int8 + a custom fused attention op.
Diego (Solutions Eng): If it's custom fused ops we need to scan the opset. Plan: 1) Tokenizer exact-match check 2) Opset/quant validator 3) Dry-run on our validator to catch missing kernels 4) Perf estimate on xG-1 / A100.
Nina (Sales): Also put together pricing options: hosted trial (best-effort) vs dedicated reserved (SLA). Include onboarding labour line (engineer-days) and optional custom-kernel engineering cost.
SecBot: CCQ preflags: customer-managed KMS, VPC peering, encryption-at-rest proof, data retention policy. Mark data residency as legal review.
Diego (Solutions Eng): If they allow us to host the artifact in our private registry that's easiest. If they insist on customer-hosted runtime we switch to Private deployment runbook.
Elena (AE): They prefer Redwood-hosted but require customer KMS + VPC.
Sam (Infra): Ballpark infra notes: reserve 1x A100-80GB for stable p99. Hosted burst possible for a short trial but no SLA. Estimate: reserved baseline + X engineer-days for onboarding. If we need custom int8 kernels add 2-3 days.
Diego (Solutions Eng): Acceptance criteria request: functional parity on 100 sample prompts + p99 <= 120ms on dedicated. Also need a sample prompt set and a 2-minute inference trace.
Elena (AE): I'll request tokenizer.json, prompt set, and a short trace from the customer today.
Nina (Sales): I'll draft a quote with optional custom-kernel work and a POC discount. Add line: variant onboarding (6 eng-days estimated).
Diego (Solutions Eng): Estimated effort: 3d compatibility + 2d perf tuning + 1d security/ccq handoff = 6 eng-days. If fused ops require work add +2-3d.
Sam (Infra): Once validator passes I'll run perf sims and share latency projections for core configs.
SecBot: CCQ template suggested answers: KMS=customer-managed, Network=VPC peering, Retention=30 days configurable, Audit logs=enabled. Flagged: residency & legal exceptions.
Elena (AE): Thanks team. I'll follow up in-thread when artifacts arrive. :thumbsup:
Diego (Solutions Eng): Ping me when tokenizer + trace are uploaded and I'll run the validator tomorrow.
Sam (Infra): Standing by for perf runs.
Nina (Sales): Will include onboarding labour and optional kernel scope in the quote.
